maddeler.e:
يستصبحوا (form X)
# يَسْتَصْبِحُوا (yastaṣbiḥū) /jas.tasˤ.bi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
# يُسْتَصْبَحُوا (yustaṣbaḥū) /jus.tasˤ.ba.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْبَحَ (istaṣbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
